title: Most Frequent Subtree Sum
description:
The subtree sum at a node is the sum of its value and all descendant values. Given a binary tree, return every subtree sum with the highest frequency, sorted in ascending order.

## Examples

```text
Input: root = [5, 2, -3]
Output: [-3, 2, 4]
```

```text
Input: root = [5, 2, -5]
Output: [2]
```

## Constraints

- The tree contains `1` to `10^4` nodes.
- `-10^5 <= Node.val <= 10^5`
